c.v: The capture signal coming to a capture channel will be inverted first, if needed, and then prescaled.
Each capture channel has a prescaler register of MCPWM_CAP
Finally, specified edges of preprocessed capture signal will trigger capture events.
The capture event occurs at the time selected by the MCPWM_CAP
When a capture event occurs, the capture timer's value is stored in time-stamp register MCPWM_CAP_CH
Different interrupts can be generated for different capture channels at capture events.
The edge that triggers a capture event is recorded in register MCPWM_CAP
The capture event can be also forced by software setting MCPWM_CAP
